title: [Shopify] Preserve manually set Sell-to Customer No. when Bill-to mapping fails
summary: Fixed a Shopify Connector bug where manually set Sell-to Customer No. was overwritten when Bill-to Customer No. failed to map, and added fallback logic to derive Bill-to from Sell-to when unmapped.
key_points: Prevent re-mapping Sell-to Customer No. when user manually set it
Add fallback to derive Bill-to Customer No. from Sell-to when Bill-to remains blank
Preserve user selections when customer mapping is incomplete
Test added to verify the fix
